headline: Tom. vaults from 1,135th into ARC-3 gold

sections.text: Tom. gained 10.93 to 37.18, moving from 1,135th to 17th.
That puts Tom. inside ARC-3’s 18 gold places; the gold line rose 0.14 to 37.12 in the past day.
